text.p: Strawbridge & Clothier said on Thursday that it has declared an initial distribution of 0.29 share of May Department Stores Co common stock for each share of Strawbridge, which is in the process of liquidating.
The company said the initial distribution is less than expected, because of reserves it has taken.
This distribution will be made to shareholders of record on July 15, 1997, Strawbridge said in a statement.
There will be no trading in the common stock of Strawbridge after July 15, 1997, and the stock transfer books of the company will be closed at the close of business on that date, Strawbridge said.

The initial distribution had been delayed due to the necessity for resolving problems at three Clover stores which the company operates, the company said. Problems at two of the stores have been resolved, it said.
Strawbridge is reserving $38 million for a landlord's claim, but the company said it believes it could resolve it for a substantially lower amount.
Also, Strawbridge is reserving approximately $20 million for ongoing expenses and certain existing and potential liabilities, the company said.

On July 18, all the assets and liabilities of the company will be placed in a liquidating trust, S&C Liquidating Trust, Strawbridge said. The trust is expected to exist for two to three years while it makes distributions to Strawbridge shareholders, the retailer said.
Strawbridge said that its present estimate of additional shares of May common stock which may be distributed is 0.08 of a May share for each Strawbridge share.
